title: Find the Original Typed String I
summary: Given a string representing the final output, determine the number of possible original strings Alice could have intended to type, considering she might have pressed a key multiple times at most once.
statement: Given a string representing the final output, determine the number of possible original strings Alice could have intended to type, considering she might have pressed a key multiple times at most once.
constraints: The displayed word may contain at most one accidental long key press.
The intended word is either unchanged or formed by deleting one character from a run of equal letters.
Return the number of distinct possible intended strings.
reference_solution:
def count_possible_original_strings(word):
    return 1+sum(word[i]==word[i-1] for i in range(1,len(word)))
hints: Always count the displayed word itself.
Within a run of length m, deleting any of its m-1 repeated positions produces m-1 distinct shorter candidates across run lengths.
Each adjacent equal pair contributes one such candidate.
Add all adjacent equal pairs to one.
editorial: Add all adjacent equal pairs to one.

tests.explanation: The unchanged word plus one deletion position per adjacent equal pair gives five possibilities.
No letter could be removed as an overlong press, so only the unchanged word is possible.
